fact: Burundi's 2026/27 state budget of BIF 7,020.6 billion allots the Ministry of Finance, Budget and Digital Economy BIF 3,033.9 billion, including a national digital identity system, land title digitalisation and a data centre.
title: Le budget de l'Etat exercice 2026/2027 fixé à 7 020,6 milliards de BIF
